seasonality_notes.dsf: Demand spike 1.6x–2.8x — electronics and fashion peak
seasonality_notes.eid: Additional 1.2x on top of Ramadan multiplier

known_limitations: Hijri calendar dates are approximated — use hijri-converter in production
Sales distribution is Gaussian — real retail is more fat-tailed
Cross-SKU demand correlation not modeled (basket effects)
calibration_note: All distribution parameters (base_demand, multipliers) are exposed as constants in generate_dataset.py. When real retailer data is available, fit these parameters against actual sales before running Prophet.
